europe_now.title: EU Commission proposes €50 billion fund for strategic technologies
europe_now.summary: The European Commission has proposed a 50 billion euro fund to invest in strategic technologies such as artificial intelligence and quantum computing, aiming to strengthen the European Union's technological competitiveness.

sources.headline: EU commission proposes €50bn tech fund to buy into AI, quantum and other strategic companies

europe_now.summary: EU Parliament members from the socialist and liberal groups have paused coordination talks with the European People's Party.

sources.headline: EU Parliament’s socialists and liberals halt talks with EPP

top_stories.title: MEPs seek billions for migration in EU budget
top_stories.summary: Members of the European Parliament are seeking additional billions in funding to address migration challenges across the European Union. The request is intended for the bloc's forthcoming seven-year budget framework.

sources.headline: MEPs want billions more to tackle migration in next seven year EU budget

top_stories.title: Trump announces new tariffs on EU and China
top_stories.summary: Former US President Donald Trump has announced new tariffs on the European Union and China. The announcement came despite his party's defeat in the US midterm elections.

sources.headline: Trump announces new tariffs on EU, China despite US midterms defeat

top_stories.summary: Moldova has issued an emergency kit guide for citizens. The guide prepares citizens for a possible expansion of the Ukraine war.
